notes.text:
Polysomnography Report
Date: 11/09/2025
Patient: Daniel Peralta, 78 y.o. M

Attended PSG 11/09/2025. Study revealed moderate-severe sleep apnea. AHI 31.8/h. CA+MA 9% of total AHI. Oxygen desaturation nadir 82%. Sleep architecture fragmented with reduced REM.

No significant arrhythmias or limb movements noted. CPAP titration recommended given severity.

Signed,
Sleep Medicine Physician

notes.title: Sleep Medicine Consultation
notes.author: Sleep medicine physician
notes.text:
Sleep Medicine Consultation
Date: 07/20/2026
Patient: Daniel Peralta, 79 y/o M

Hx: Pt c/o persistent daytime somnolence, despite adherence to CPAP therapy.

PE: BMI 32, no acute distress, oropharynx clear, no nasal obstruction.

Sleep Study: CPAP 11 cmH2O, residual AHI 24.1 despite nightly use = failure.

Assessment: Severe OSA refractory to current CPAP settings.

Plan: Consider alternative therapies including BiPAP or ASV. Evaluate for positional therapy and possible adjunctive pharmacotherapy. Follow-up sleep study after adjustments.

Pt advised on importance of compliance and scheduled for re-evaluation in 3 months.
